subject.character: ONE stag; a cabin (smoking chimney, door, shuttered window) on his antlers, flung onto the stump at 3.95; muzzle grays at 0.80 and stays gray; same face throughout
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE badger, vest, visor; in the cab until 6.60, then enters by the door
props: red ribbon; yellow bulldozer, ПОД СНОС on its blade; kettle on a hook; inside, seen only from 7.30: mounted trophy head with the stag's own face, glass eyes, gray muzzle

lighting: warm sun behind-left, sky glow behind-right, high contrast; sunbeams through the window
motion_rule: Camera arcs or orbits every beat, shot size changes, trees slide behind, never still; except 7.30: camera flies in through the window. Stag moves his whole body every beat.
